content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 2 for Project Research Scientist I and 3 for Technical Assistant.

content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I Qualifications: PhD degree in Life sciences/Allied sciences from a recognised university. Experience: Candidates with hands-on experience in culture characterisation and cryopreservation of stem cells will be given preference. Technical Assistant Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life sciences /Allied sciences/Computational system biology from a recognized university or equivalent. Experience: Candidates with hands-on experience in cell culture and animals will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIAB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIAB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NIAB Project Research Scientist –I / Technical Assistant posts is 09 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies have been announced in the NIAB Recruitment 2026. These include 2 positions for Project Research Scientist –I and 3 positions for Technical Assistant across various research areas.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for Project Research Scientist –I?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Research Scientist –I must possess a PhD degree in Life sciences or Allied sciences from a recognized university. Preference will be given to those with experience in stem cell culture and cryopreservation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Assistant post is 50 years. There is no minimum age specified, and age relaxation details should be checked in the official notification if applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist –I?
faq.answer: The Project Research Scientist –I position offers a salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month, along with an additional 30% HRA (House Rent Allowance) if applicable. This makes it a competitive package for research professionals.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for NIAB posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NIAB Project Research Scientist –I / Technical Assistant posts is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the application form through the official website www.niab.res.in.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NIAB Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for NIAB Recruitment involves initial screening of applications, followed by intimation to shortlisted candidates via email. Finally, selected candidates will undergo an interview conducted by a duly constituted selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Research Scientist –I / Technical Assistant positions is Hyderabad, Telangana. The National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB) is located at Survey No. 37, Gachibowli, Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for NIAB Recruitment?
faq.answer: According to the extracted data, no specific application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the NIAB Project Research Scientist –I / Technical Assistant recruitment. Candidates should confirm this detail from the official PDF.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to apply?
faq.answer: The official website to apply for the NIAB Project Research Scientist –I / Technical Assistant recruitment and to find more details is www.niab.res.in. All applications must be submitted through this portal.
